## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

Build Figure 2

### Background

### Data sources

-   Loadings and weights for Factor 1 from Figure 1
-   All transporters associated with top hits from Factor 1 from Recon3D
-   All export transporters from Recon3D
-   All transport-related genes from Reactome

Patient data: - brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 - TCGA files on breast cancer - Files of interest are the between-sample-normalized RNA sequencing counts in data_RNA_Seq_v2_expression_median.txt and metadata on molecular subtypes in data_clinical_patient.txt - Origin is https://www.cbioportal.org/datasets Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA, PanCancer Atlas) with reference TCGA, Cell 2018 downloaded on 8-4-2021

### Analysis plan

-   A: all metabolite rates of interest without scaling/with zero as zero scaled to the max
-   B: transporters of interest and factor 1
-   C: correlation of all transporters reactome & link to factor 1 and 2
-   D: correlation of all transporters Recon3D & link to factor 1 and 2

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

#### Visualization settings for the report

```{r}
options(digits = 3) # visualizations of tables
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
data_dir <- here("data", "figure_2")
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Figure2_{datestamp}")))
```

### Figure 2A

-   A: all metabolite rates of interest without scaling/with zero as zero scaled to the max

Same as for Figure 1 but without autoscaling. Now it is min-max scaling.

Select transporters for top most extreme rates in factor 1. I chose cutoff weight 0.5.

```{r}
factors <- read_csv(here(
  "manuscript", str_glue("Figure1_{datestamp}"),
  "Figure1BC.csv"
))

metabolite_rates <- read_csv(here(
  data_dir,
  "metabolite_rates_scaled_minmax.csv"
)) |>
  pivot_longer(!metabolite,
    names_to = "cell_line",
    values_to = "scaled_minmax_rate"
  ) |>
  left_join(factors, by = "cell_line")
head(metabolite_rates)

weights <- read_csv(here(
  "manuscript", str_glue("Figure1_{datestamp}"),
  "Figure1DE.csv"
))

rates_of_interest <- weights |>
  filter(view == "metabolite rates") |>
  filter(abs(Factor1) > 0.5) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(Factor1)))
head(rates_of_interest)

metabolite_rates <- metabolite_rates |>
  left_join(
    select(rates_of_interest, feature, Factor1) |>
      rename(weight_Factor1 = Factor1),
    by = c("metabolite" = "feature")
  )

write_csv(
  metabolite_rates,
  here(output_dir, "Figure2A.csv")
)
```

### Figure 2B

-   B: transporters of interest and factor 1

```{r}
cell_line_metadata <- read_csv(here("data/cell_line_metadata.csv"))
cell_line_metadata <- cell_line_metadata |>
  left_join(
    factors |>
      select(CellLine, Factor1, Factor2, Factor3, Factor4),
    by = "CellLine"
  )
```

Data from previous project from our group PMID:33790333

```{r}
transcriptomics <- read_csv(here(
  data_dir,
  "RNAseq_log2normalized_counts_celllines.csv"
)) |>
  select(-NCBI_Gene_ID)

# Change dashes in cell line names into dots for use in MOFA
# and match with my naming convention.
colnames(transcriptomics) <- str_replace_all(colnames(transcriptomics), "-", "")

setdiff(colnames(transcriptomics), cell_line_metadata$CellLine)
setdiff(cell_line_metadata$CellLine, colnames(transcriptomics))
cell_line_metadata <- cell_line_metadata |>
  filter(CellLine %in% colnames(transcriptomics))
setdiff(cell_line_metadata$CellLine, colnames(transcriptomics))

## Check for NA values
any(is.na(transcriptomics))

# Filter for expressed genes
dim(transcriptomics)
transcriptomics <- transcriptomics |>
  filter(rowSums(transcriptomics >= 4) >= 5)
dim(transcriptomics)
```

Use the list of transporters that match a metabolite as defined in the Recon3D model. These are all genes matched to at least one of the metabolites for which we have metabolite rates.

```{r}
recon3D_transporter_genes_NCBI <- read_csv(
  here(data_dir, "gene_to_metabolite_hits.csv")
)
head(recon3D_transporter_genes_NCBI)
nrow(recon3D_transporter_genes_NCBI)

# Filter for exchange related to factor 1
recon3D_transporters <- filter(
  recon3D_transporter_genes_NCBI,
  identifiers %in% rates_of_interest$feature
) |>
  filter(subSystems == "Transport, extracellular")
nrow(recon3D_transporters)
head(recon3D_transporters)

# Nr of unique genes
unique(recon3D_transporters$gene_symbol)
length(unique(recon3D_transporters$gene_symbol))
```

Filter transcriptome data for the transporters.

```{r}
t_transporters <- transcriptomics |>
  inner_join(
    select(recon3D_transporters, Ensembl_gene_ID) |> unique(),
    by = c("EnsemblID" = "Ensembl_gene_ID")
  ) |>
  select(-EnsemblID) |>
  relocate(gene_symbol)
nrow(t_transporters)

for_cor <- t_transporters |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "CellLine") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "gene_symbol") |>
  arrange(CellLine) |>
  column_to_rownames("CellLine")

all(rownames(for_cor) == cell_line_metadata$CellLine)

cor_factors <- cor(for_cor, select(cell_line_metadata, all_of(contains("Factor"))),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"
) |>
  data.frame() |>
  arrange(desc(abs(Factor1)))


# Check for hits with correlations in factor 1
top_hits_factor1 <- cor_factors |>
  filter(
    abs(Factor1) > 0.4
  )
top_hits_factor1

top_hits_factor1 |>
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
  left_join(recon3D_transporter_genes_NCBI, by = "gene_symbol") |>
  relocate(gene_name, `Protein names`, .after = identifiers) |>
  write_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2B_metadata.csv"))

# What is now left are transporters transporting one or more of the detected
# metabolites, that also correlate with factor 1, but not with factor 2.
t_transporters |>
  filter(gene_symbol %in% rownames(top_hits_factor1)) |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "cell_line", values_to = "log2_expression") |>
  left_join(cell_line_metadata, by = c("cell_line" = "CellLine")) |>
  write_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2B.csv"))
```

#### Supplementary Figure

Compare gene expression of targets of interest in patients, related to molecular subtypes.

For someone rerunning this code: check gitignore on how to download this file. It is not mine, so I cannot put it in this git repository.

```{r}
# Patient tissue
patient_RNAseq <- read_tsv(here("data", "brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018", "data_RNA_Seq_v2_expression_median.txt")) |>
  filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% rownames(top_hits_factor1)) |>
  pivot_longer(!c(Hugo_Symbol, Entrez_Gene_Id), names_to = "patient_ID", values_to = "gene_expression") |>
  mutate(log2_gene_expression = log2(gene_expression + 1))
dim(patient_RNAseq)
patient_RNAseq[1:5, 1:5]

#### Healthy tissue
normal_RNAseq <- read_tsv(here(
  "data", "brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018",
  "data_RNA_Seq_v2_mRNA_median_normals.txt"
)) |>
  filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% rownames(top_hits_factor1)) |>
  pivot_longer(!c(Hugo_Symbol, Entrez_Gene_Id),
    names_to = "patient_ID", values_to = "gene_expression"
  ) |>
  mutate(log2_gene_expression = log2(gene_expression + 1))
dim(normal_RNAseq)
normal_RNAseq[1:5, 1:5]

#### Metadata
metadata <- read_tsv(
  here(
    "data", "brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018",
    "data_clinical_patient.txt"
  ),
  comment = "#"
) |>
  # remove all male
  filter(SEX != "MALE") |>
  # Remove all without defined subtype
  filter(!is.na(SUBTYPE)) |>
  mutate(
    normal = str_c(PATIENT_ID, "-11"),
    patient = str_c(PATIENT_ID, "-01")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(normal, patient, SUBTYPE) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(normal, patient),
    names_to = "design_group", values_to = "patient_ID"
  ) |>
  mutate(SUBTYPE = ifelse(design_group == "normal", "normal tissue", SUBTYPE))
dim(metadata)
head(metadata)
tail(metadata)

unique(metadata$SUBTYPE)

# Combine to one data frame with metadata
transporter_data_pat <- bind_rows(
  normal_RNAseq,
  patient_RNAseq
) |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "patient_ID")
dim(transporter_data_pat)
head(transporter_data_pat)
tail(transporter_data_pat)

# Quality control of data processing. There should not be any NA left.
if (any(is.na(transporter_data_pat))) stop

transporter_data_pat |>
  write_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2-Supplementary_Fig.csv"))
```

### Figure 2C

-   C: correlation of all transporters Recon3D & link to factor 2

```{r}
ex_transport_genes <- read_csv(
  here(data_dir, "ex_transport_genes.csv"),
  col_types = "c"
)
head(ex_transport_genes)
nrow(ex_transport_genes)

unique_transporter_genes <- unique(ex_transport_genes$NCBI_Gene_ID)
length(unique_transporter_genes)
head(unique_transporter_genes)
str(unique_transporter_genes)

t_transporters <- transcriptomics |>
  inner_join(
    select(ex_transport_genes, Ensembl_gene_ID) |> distinct(),
    by = c("EnsemblID" = "Ensembl_gene_ID")
  ) |>
  select(-EnsemblID) |>
  relocate(gene_symbol)
nrow(t_transporters)

t_transporters |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol") |>
  t() |>
  cor() |>
  data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
  write_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2C.csv"))
```

Correlate gene expression with metadata and previously established factor loadings.

```{r}
for_cor <- t_transporters |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "CellLine") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "gene_symbol") |>
  arrange(CellLine) |>
  column_to_rownames("CellLine")

all(rownames(for_cor) == cell_line_metadata$CellLine)

cor_factors <- cor(for_cor,
  select(
    cell_line_metadata,
    all_of(contains("Factor")), ProliferationRate, EMT_score
  ),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"
) |>
  data.frame()

all_hits_factor1 <- cor_factors |>
  filter(
    abs(Factor1) > 0.4,
    abs(Factor2) < 0.4
  )
head(all_hits_factor1)

all_hits_factor2 <- cor_factors |>
  filter(
    abs(Factor1) < 0.4,
    abs(Factor2) > 0.4
  )
head(all_hits_factor2)

cor_factors |>
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
  write_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2C_correlations.csv"))
```

cor_factors <- cor(for_cor,
  select(
    cell_line_metadata,
    all_of(contains("Factor")), ProliferationRate, EMT_score
  ),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"
) |>

all_hits_factor1 <- cor_factors |>

Check top 5 EMT associated hits

```{r}
top_M <- cor_factors |>
  arrange(EMT_score) |>
  select(EMT_score) |>
  mutate(EMT_score = round(EMT_score, digits = 2)) |>
  tail(10)
top_M

top_E <- cor_factors |>
  arrange(EMT_score) |>
  select(EMT_score) |>
  mutate(EMT_score = round(EMT_score, digits = 2)) |>
  head(10)
top_E

t_transporters |>
  filter(gene_symbol %in% rownames(top_M)) |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "CellLine") |>
  left_join(cell_line_metadata, by = "CellLine") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = EMT_score, y = value)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~gene_symbol, scales = "free_y")

t_transporters |>
  filter(gene_symbol %in% rownames(top_E)) |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "CellLine") |>
  left_join(cell_line_metadata, by = "CellLine") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = EMT_score, y = value)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~gene_symbol, scales = "free_y")

t_transporters |>
  filter(gene_symbol %in% c("ABCC4")) |>
  pivot_longer(!gene_symbol, names_to = "CellLine") |>
  left_join(cell_line_metadata, by = "CellLine") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = EMT_score, y = value)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~gene_symbol, scales = "free_y")
```
